row.evidence: getcensus.com/pricing now redirects to Fivetran's pricing page, which lists "SCIM/user provisioning" under Enterprise; the Census Migration FAQ says moving Activations access controls to Fivetran brings "SCIM provisioning".
row.notes: New row. Census joined Fivetran and is sold as Fivetran Activations: month-to-month Census plans ended March 2026, annual ones run to term, then Census Professional maps to Fivetran Standard and Enterprise/Enterprise Lite to Enterprise. Pricing is usage-based (MAR), so per-user fields are null. SAML SSO is on all Fivetran plans; SCIM (Okta catalogue app, Entra non-gallery app at https://api.fivetran.com/scim/v2) needs Enterprise or Business Critical and covers Activations users once their access controls move to Fivetran's Users & Permissions. Deactivation soft-deletes the user. The Fivetran REST API (all plans) lists, invites, updates and deletes users. Research mirrors the fivetran row, which covers the same platform.

auth.token_source: Fivetran Account Settings > General > SCIM Config > Enable SCIM Provisioning > Generate

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users are soft-deleted and stay greyed out in the Fivetran user list.

roles.how: Account-level role via roles[primary eq "True"].value; team roles and destination/connector-level roles cannot be set via SCIM.

limitations.text: Only Okta (catalogue app) and Microsoft Entra ID (non-gallery app) are supported SCIM clients.
Email and username must match; once SCIM is on, users are managed only from the IdP.
Groups map to teams, but team roles and group roles are not synced.
Applies to Census (Activations) users once their access controls have moved to Fivetran's Users & Permissions; legacy Census workspace access controls had no SCIM.

scim.notes: Census is now Fivetran Activations; its users and access controls move to Fivetran's, so SCIM is Fivetran's SCIM API.

rate_limits.text: Account-level rolling limits per action, higher on paid plans than trials.

limitations.text: The legacy Census (Activations) organization API for users and invitations at app.getcensus.com uses personal access tokens; user and access management is moving to Fivetran's API.

okta.notes: OIN 'Fivetran' app marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Gallery app exists for SSO; SCIM uses a non-gallery enterprise app pointed at the Fivetran SCIM URL, so row.idp.entra is via_generic.

google.notes: SAML SSO with a setup guide; Google Workspace is not set up from an app catalogue and has no SCIM.

onelogin.notes: SSO setup guide only; SCIM is supported only for Okta and Entra ID.

fallbacks.notes: Legacy Census workspaces invited users by email into the organization and workspace.

open_questions: Do customers still on an annual legacy Census plan get SCIM before their access controls move to Fivetran? The FAQ gives no date.
Does SCIM deactivation free anything billable? Pricing is usage-based with unlimited users, so likely not, but it is undocumented.
Is there an audit-log API covering Activations? Not checked in the Fivetran docs.
